changelog.note: 231 (stage F, F2; the owner's decisions of 2026-10-29: the full move into a data file): the S path's candidate finder's patterns, limits and profiles, until now constants of jav/ai/candidates.py, moved here unchanged (every pattern's text and flags are pinned in tests/test_candidate_profiles_231.py; the S path's requests and the candidates in tests/test_select_keys_231.py). A profile names its patterns by key; two switches replace a profile name the code used to compare: `name_fallback_combined` (the `hu` profile's combined name fallback limit) and `evidence_intl` (the G path's evidence reads numbers in the international forms). A new profile is data alone; a type pack names it in `candidate_profile`.

231 (F2c; the owner's decision of 2026-10-29: the terms and conditions' S path): the `terms` profile, the international one with the party labels of a seller's terms and conditions (`party_label_terms`). Read only by the terms and conditions' S path (its select call site names it); every other profile is unchanged.

iban_intl.note: A foreign IBAN (not HU): country code, 2 check digits and 11-30 letters or digits, also in space-separated groups.

taxid_formatted.note: The Hungarian tax number in its printed form (12345678-1-23).

taxid_contiguous.note: The Hungarian tax number without hyphens (11 digits, standalone).

taxid_eu.note: The Hungarian EU VAT number (HU + 8 digits).

taxid_eu_intl.note: 065, 069: a foreign tax number: an EU / UK / Swiss / Norwegian (with MVA) / Turkish / Ukrainian / Serbian form after a real country code, the Irish form with its trailing letter, the EU OSS registration number, the Swiss CHE form; a match is a candidate only as a recognised form (jav/core/taxid.py), in its canonical spelling.

taxid_label_intl.note: 069: a tax number label; EIN is a label only in capitals (the German article 'ein' is not).

taxid_label_token.note: An identifier token after a tax number label: EIN 12-3456789, VKN 10 digits, ABN 11 digits.

invoice_label.note: The invoice number labels of a Hungarian invoice; 127: a credit note's or corrective invoice's own number is labelled by the document's own name.

invoice_label_intl.note: 065, 066, 127: the invoice number labels in several languages; on a receipt the order, payment, receipt or transaction id is the document number (with word boundaries: an advertising line 'Order now' is not a label).

invoice_title.note: 065: a title line ('Elektronikus számla', 'Invoice') with a single identifier below it (the number stands below the title without a label).

invoice_token.note: An identifier-shaped token: an invoice number candidate.

amount_token.note: 066: an amount-shaped token (1 250,00 / 45.00 / 1,250.00) is not an invoice number candidate: the money finder's job.

money.note: 081: a number is matched whole, never a piece of it; the English thousands group is one number in the Hungarian profile too, and no match is followed by a further digit of the same number. The reading itself is jav/core/numbers.py.

money_intl.note: The international money form: also the English thousands comma with a decimal point ('1,600.00', '12,345', '$42.50') as one match.

quantity.note: 081: a quantity also takes a fraction of three or more digits ('1.0000' correction factor, '0,9853'), which money never has.

percent_after.note: A number followed by a percent sign is a rate, not an amount or a quantity.

total_line.note: A totals line: kept when a request's lines are cut to its budget (jav/ai/jev_select.py).

reverse_charge.note: Reverse charge printed: with no 0 amount a synthetic 0 money candidate (VAT) is offered, as JEV can only choose an offered value.

currency_hint.note: A currency sign or code in the text.

legal_form.note: The Hungarian invoice's legal forms (a name candidate is a cell with one).

legal_form_intl.note: The legal forms of several countries.

party_label.note: 127: a party label is a whole word (a customer-code label is not the buyer label followed by 'code').

party_label_intl.note: The party labels in several languages.

label_only.note: A cell holding only a label is not a name.

label_only_intl.note: A cell holding only a label is not a name (several languages, letter-spaced headings too).

name_trailing_id.note: An identifier after a comma at a name's end is cut from it.

address.note: A Hungarian address: a four-digit postcode before a capitalised place name.

address_intl.note: A foreign address: a postcode form or a street with a house number.

address_stop_intl.note: Date-, period-, identifier- and amount-like cells are not addresses.

payment_method_line.note: A payment method line: kept when a request's lines are cut to its budget.

legal_form_utility.note: The utility bills' legal forms (OCR text of Hungarian utility bills).

party_label_utility.note: OCR-tolerant party labels: a character class in place of accented letters (OCR may also read 'Elosztéi engedélyes', 'Felhasznalo').

address_label_utility.note: Address labels cut from an address candidate ('Felhasználó címe:').

label_only_utility.regex: (?i)^(?:számla|e-számla|sorszám|kiállító|vevő|eladó|szállító|felhasználó|vevő\s*\(fizető\)|szolgáltató|számlatulajdonos|elosztói engedélyes|oldalszám.*|számlarészletező|terhelési összesítő|feladóvevény|postai számlabefizetési megbízás|villamos energia|elszámoló számla|részszámla|számla sorszáma|fizetési mód|fizetendő összeg|elszámolási időszak|fizetési határidő|összeg|forint|posta|tájékoztató adatok|áfa összesítő.*)\s*[:：]?$
label_only_utility.note: A cell holding only a utility bill label is not a name.

invoice_label_utility.note: The invoice number labels of a utility bill.

taxid_ocr.note: OCR: a space may slip into the 8-digit block of the tax number; the form with the spaces removed is a candidate if it passes the check-digit test.

taxid_label_hu.note: A Hungarian tax number label, OCR-tolerant.

partial_hu_iban.note: A Hungarian IBAN broken over lines: its first part.

iban_group.note: A Hungarian IBAN broken over lines: a further group of four digits.

quantity_line.note: A quantity line (utility bill itemisation, meter table): a unit or a meter label in the line; the meter line is also recognised by its reading code if OCR garbled the header.

leading_article.note: A leading article is not part of a name.

greeting.note: 127: a greeting before the addressee's name ('Dear <Name>,') is not part of the name.

address_tail.note: 127: an address after a complete name in the same cell: a postcode or a street with a house number, optionally after a comma.

name_stop.note: A name cell with any of these is not a name candidate.

incomplete_legal_form.note: 127: a legal-form adjective that still wants its noun ('társaság') from the next line.

name_goes_on.note: 129: a continuation that still belongs to a registered name: a partner, a branch, a winding-up state, a trading name.

name_tail_separator.note: 129: a remark after a name starts after a separator.

party_label_terms.note: 231 (F2c): the international party labels and those of a seller's terms and conditions: the company name ('Cégnév:') and the operator of a shop ('Üzlet üzemeltetője:').
